rationale: Acceptance lens did not run (no spec/story), so decision_needed was unavailable and confidence is low; blind, edge-case and verification-gap ran and every candidate was checked against source. Three blocking findings: the trim() whitespace fallback (reachability unconfirmed, capped major) and two code-quality.md Types And Imports violations (Optional[...] at 4 sites, bare dict on _SORT_COLUMN_MAP) that ruff does not enforce. 0 deferred; 14 dismissed as handled/unreachable/below floor (func already imported, username NOT NULL, router Literal validation is the only caller path, id tie-breaker and no-migration are required by the task).

findings.title: Bare dict annotation on _SORT_COLUMN_MAP
findings.problem: code-quality.md (Types And Imports) says to avoid bare dict annotations and prefer parameterized generics; the new _SORT_COLUMN_MAP class attribute is annotated with a bare dict.
findings.impact: The project's documented code-quality standard is blocking for the review gate and no automated lint rule enforces it, so new code lands in violation.
findings.recommendation: Parameterize the annotation, e.g. `dict[str, ColumnElement[str]]` (or the matching SQLAlchemy expression type), to conform to code-quality.md Types And Imports.

findings.title: trim() misses non-space whitespace names
findings.problem: The name sort key is lower(coalesce(nullif(trim(name), ''), username)). Postgres trim() with no characters argument removes only spaces, so a name consisting of tabs, newlines or non-breaking spaces is not treated as empty and does not fall back to username, contrary to the requirement and the code comment (NULL, empty or whitespace-only).
findings.impact: Users whose name is non-space whitespace sort by a blank-looking key (typically at the start of an asc page) instead of by username, so the Users list appears out of order. Reachability unconfirmed: whether IDP-provisioned names can contain such characters was not established.
findings.recommendation: Strip all whitespace before the empty check, e.g. `func.nullif(func.regexp_replace(UserDB.name, r'^\s+|\s+$', '', 'g'), '')` (Postgres), or narrow the comment/requirement to space-only; update NAME_EXPR in the sort test and add a case for a tab/newline-only name.

findings.title: Optional[...] used for new sort_by params
findings.problem: code-quality.md (Types And Imports) says to avoid typing.Optional[X] and prefer X | None; the new sort_by parameters are annotated Optional[Literal["name"]] at user_repository.py:194, user_management_router.py:135, user_management_service.py:332 and :519.
findings.impact: The project's documented code-quality standard is blocking for the review gate; ruff's selected rules do not include UP, so no gate catches it and the new code lands in violation.
findings.recommendation: Annotate sort_by as `Literal["name"] | None` at all four sites: user_repository.py:194, user_management_router.py:135, user_management_service.py:332 and :519.
